status: descriptive real-data pilot across four structures; no architecture-routing claim

datasets.genotype: BioNumPy/1000 Genomes fixed 50x38 panel archived in EXP013B
datasets.tabular: scikit-learn Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer, 569x30 features
datasets.time_series: statsmodels annual sunspots 1700-2008, converted to 12-lag -> 3-future windows
datasets.graph: NetworkX Zachary karate club, 34x34 binary adjacency profiles

finding: The same structure-agnostic passport calculation runs on genotype, ordinary tabular measurements, lagged time-series windows and graph adjacency profiles, and produces markedly different observed/predictive spectra, sparsity and stability profiles. This establishes a common measurement interface, not a universal clustering law.
evidence_boundary: One real dataset represents each structure in this pilot. The next atlas stage needs multiple datasets per structure before testing whether geometry predicts model-family routing better than type labels.
